title: Ben Pazi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 46a: Ulla said, “I was standing before Bar Pazi, and they brought a bird before him; he examined it up to between the wings. The Patriarch’s house sent for him, and he rose and went,” etc. Hyman says that undoubtedly he is Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi.

notes.text: “Undoubtedly” is Hyman’s degree of confidence in identifying Bar Pazi with Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi. The William Davidson digital Chullin 46a confirms Ulla’s account but does not itself give Shimon’s full name.
The consulted Aramaic has Ben Pazi in Ulla’s account. The body follows Hyman’s Bar Pazi.
